tasks.title: Focal length in pixels from the field of view
tasks.statement: The frame is **{w} px** wide and the horizontal field of view is **{fov}°**. Find f_x (px).
tasks.solution: f_x = (W/2) / tan(HFOV/2): half the frame width against half the angle.

tasks.title: Depth from stereo
tasks.statement: A stereo pair: f = **{f} px**, baseline **{b} cm**, disparity **{d} px**. Find the depth (m).
tasks.solution: Z = f·B/d (B in meters). An error of 1 px of disparity at small d gives a large depth error: stereo accuracy falls with the square of the distance.

tasks.title: How much ground one pixel covers
tasks.statement: f = **{f} px**, distance to the object **{z} m**. What size does 1 pixel cover (cm)?
tasks.solution: Size of a pixel on the object = Z/f. At f = 800 and 100 m it is 12.5 cm: a detection error of a couple of pixels is a quarter of a meter.
